chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): that he said:
To the Banu Hashim: You are the weak/lowly ones after me.

key_terms.الْمُسْتَضْعَفُونَ: The weak, the lowly, or those lacking political/military power
key_terms.بَنِي هَاشِمٍ: Banu Hashim, the clan of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to the Banu Hashim about their status after his death?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) identifies the Banu Hashim as 'al-mustad'afun' (the weak or marginalized) following his death, a designation that Shia scholars interpret as foreshadowing their political and social disenfranchisement during the Caliphate era. This status underscores the unique spiritual and temporal burden placed upon the Ahl al-Bayt, distinguishing their position of quiet endurance from the ruling authorities. The term highlights not merely a lack of power, but a specific historical reality of being overshadowed by other tribes while retaining the mantle of prophetic authority.
